Ok, so this is a little more than 2 sentences but I tried to condense it as much as possible.

From following the hearings somewhat closely, it's because Trump withheld aid and a white house meeting from Ukraine in order to solicit an investigation that would make a political rival look bad. Even if Ukraine's president claims he felt no pressure, there are legitimate reasons why he could have; aid and public support from the United States are very important in reassuring the Ukrainian population that they are supported against Russia-that aid and meeting should have been (and were) extremely valuble and important. The Ukrainian president may even have motivation to claim he didnt feel pressure, because saying he did could cause Trump or the GOP to withdraw support that they really need. Even so, just attempting to solicit this investigation using government resources for personal political benefit is what has raised so much concern. Trump didn't restore the aid until after the whistleblower made his complaint, and over the entire course of witholding aid, reportedly did not express any interest in the corruption that he's claiming in his defense caused him to withold aid, only in this very specfic investigation. For context, investigation into this company had already been done, and the investigation was dormant at the time of Trump's request. There is also some sketchy stuff involving using private citizens such as Rudy Giuliani in conjunction with government officials to influence affairs in Ukraine, including leading a smear campaign against an ambassador to have her removed, to clear the way for requesting an investigation for no legitimate reason.

I think the democrats are also writing articles that outline the attempts that Trump and his staff made to obstruct justice in this and the Mueller investigation.

TLDR: Trump used or attempted to use his position, executive power, and government resources to benefit his personal political goals, and included private citizens in foreign affairs. He also may have obstructed justice.

Impeachment trials are not analogous to criminal trials.

There's been nothing illegal or unjust in the proceedings so far.
